description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  Probes: scratch/s473t3/probes/p21-misc.pl, p22-vstring-str.pl,
p23b.pl (the whole ref.t ref-type table, reconstructed).

ROW (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 1 row):
  ref.t 67 `stringify for ref to vstring`
           got `'SCALAR(0xf)'`, expected `^VSTRING\(0x[0-9a-f]+\)$`

WHAT WAS MEASURED (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl, on d9a2aac0):
  (a) `my $vs = \v1; print ref($vs), " ", "$vs";`
      perl `VSTRING VSTRING(0x...)`, PCL `VSTRING VSTRING(0x1)` -- AGREE.
  (b) the whole 24-row ref-type table of perl-tests/ref.t:214-238, rebuilt
      with its `my $pviv/$pvnv/$x`, `sub PVBM`, `sub mysub` context and
      printing `ref($ref)` and `"$ref"` per row: every row is IDENTICAL
      between perl and PCL, including `vstring VSTRING(0x...)`, except
      `format`, which is empty in BOTH (already registered).
  (c) `perl tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl --jobs 1 perl-tests/ref.t` on this tree
      produces 196 pass / 15 fail and the vstring row is NOT among the
      failures; the file reaches test 242 of 245, well past 67.

WHY THE BLESSED `got` IS STALE, not merely different: the recorded value is
`SCALAR(0xf)` -- address 0xf, i.e. the 15th reference stringified in the run.
In the table as it stands today the 15th entry is `pos lvalue`, and the
vstring is the 12th.  The three `LVALUE` entries (`\substr`, `\pos`,
`\vec`) were only implemented in session 219 (`p-substr-ref`/`p-pos-ref`/
`p-vec-ref`); before that they were not refs at all, the counter ran three
short, and the vstring landed on 0xf.  So the row was blessed against a
pre-s219 tree and its shape has since been fixed.

WHAT TO DO WITH IT: the next FULL sweep is the arbiter.  If it reports this
row FIXED, it leaves `baselines/fail-baseline.tsv` BY EDIT with this task as
its cause and this task is closed.  If it still FAILS under `--jobs 4`, then
it is a concurrency-visible row of the `magic.t 184/185/186/201` kind
(s473t2: four rows that pass alone and fail in the blessed run, KEPT rather
than removed) and this task records that instead.  It is NOT to be removed on
the strength of a `--jobs 1` single-file run.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md ref.t, "vstring refs (tests
64-65): `ref(\v1)` should be 'VSTRING'" -- that half is DONE; `ref` answers
VSTRING in PCL today.

=== MEASURED, s473t3 full sweep (--jobs 4, tree with the baseline edit) ===
perl-tests/ref.t ran 242 of 245 rows (196 pass / 15 fail) and
`stringify for ref to vstring` is NOT among the 15 -- it PASSED, well past its
own row 67.  But `tools/sweep-diff.pl` classifies ref.t as PARTIAL and therefore
reports its three absent baseline fails as UNVERIFIED, never as FIXED -- so the
row is NOT removed.  THE ROW STAYS until ref.t stops being PARTIAL and a full
sweep calls it fixed; only then does it leave `baselines/fail-baseline.tsv` by
EDIT with this task as its cause.  (Same discipline as the s473t2 magic.t
184/185/186/201 decision: never remove a row on evidence a PARTIAL file cannot
give.)
